items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: Tommy Mitchell taught me a lot

ctx.x: Jack Jeffers was just coming on the scene and Benny Powell was still with Basie. He hadn't come off the road with Basie yet, you know. And I was the only one, actually, playing bass trombone. And I had a ball with it. And I practically learned that myself, too, but Tommy Mitchell taught me a lot, Bart Varso (ng), I would ask him a million questions when I saw him about the horn, and Tony Studd was my greatest teacher.
